title: RealWorldEvalReport
description: JSON Schema for reports emitted by backend/audio_model/evaluate_real_world.py. Validates the deterministic real-world evaluation report defined in design.md section 4.3 and required by R1.4.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this report shape (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).

evaluated_at_iso8601.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which evaluation completed.

git_sha.description: Short or full lowercase-hex git commit SHA the report was produced against.

checkpoint_id.description: Filename of the Audio_Detector checkpoint that was evaluated.

checkpoint_sha256.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the checkpoint file bytes.

n_clips.description: Number of clips actually included in the metrics.

n_clips_excluded.description: Number of clips skipped per R1.6 (missing, wrong format, decode error, etc.).

confusion_matrix.description: 2D array of non-negative integers. Rows index true labels, columns index predicted labels.

per_class.description: Optional per-class breakdown. Keys are class names (e.g. 'crash', 'noise').
